name: spectrum-buddy
description: Chrome Extension to fetch assignment deadlines from Spectrum LMS

scripts.firefox: npm run build && node scripts/patch-manifest.js && npx web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.lint: npm run build && node scripts/patch-manifest.js && npx web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/patch-manifest.js && npx web-ext build --source-dir dist --overwrite-dest
